strengths.s: You keep going rather than stopping when something is difficult. That single habit is worth more than it looks, because the marking rewards sustained speech.
The basic structures are there and correct. What is missing is variety, not knowledge, and variety is quicker to build than knowledge.
You understand questions the first time and answer what was actually asked. Examiners notice this immediately, and it makes the whole conversation easier for both people.
You know a great deal of English that has never been asked to come out of your mouth at speed. That is a storage problem rather than a knowledge problem, and it is a far shorter job.

weaknesses.n: The same safe words on rotation
weaknesses.meta: A small set, used often and correctly
Which, who and that doing no work
English learned as a written subject

units.name: Homework for Life, the starter week
units.reason: the polished answers are not the problem. The empty shelf behind them is. This builds the shelf, one line a night, so that the next time a cue card lands you are choosing between real memories instead of reaching for a script.

units.name: Specificity, name it exactly
units.from: The same safe words on rotation
units.reason: the safe twenty words are doing all the work, and they are hiding everything else you know. This exercise pulls the precise words out of your own life rather than out of a list.

units.name: Sprints, not streams, chunk and pause
units.reason: the pace rises exactly where the accuracy needs to hold. This exercise puts the pauses back in, at the joints, where they are scored as control rather than hesitation.
